subject: Vendor master harmonization + onboarding checklist — GreenWave Logistics
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tara Green <tara.green@greenwave.io>, accounts@greenwave.io
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor master harmonization + onboarding checklist — GreenWave Logistics

Hi Tara / GreenWave accounts team,

Thanks again for partnering with Redwood. We're kicking off the vendor onboarding so finance and procurement can issue POs quickly for your initial integration work. A few items we've spotted on our side that will speed up set-up: 

- We appear to have two supplier records for GreenWave in our master (internal IDs GW-23 and GW-122). Can you confirm the legal entity name(s) you want us to use?
- Please confirm the remit (payment) address and the address used for tax reporting.
- We need an up-to-date W-9 (or W-8 if applicable) and a bank letter or voided check for ACH setup (bank details redaction ok in email — we'll accept DocuSign).
- If there are any preferred PO/PO-numbering contact details or AP contact persons, please share.

I've attached the Redwood onboarding checklist and the bank authorization template to this thread. Can you review and return the completed items by end of next week (Fri 9/18)? If GreenWave confirms that GW-23 and GW-122 are duplicates, we will request the vendor master team to merge and keep the record with the preferred remit address.

Immediate asks for GreenWave:
1) Confirm legal name to be used on POs (exact string).
2) Confirm remit address (street, city, state/province, postal code, country).
3) Send W-9 + signed bank authorization (PDF).

Internal note: Karthik — when GreenWave confirms, can you kick off the duplicate merge and flag any historical payments for PO re-association? Laura / Monica — please hold any new POs until we mark the master record reconciled, unless there is an urgent SOW (we'll triage).

Thanks — looking forward to getting you live.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Procurement Programs Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- RW_onboarding_checklist_v2.pdf (onboarding checklist, steps + required docs)
- bank_authorization_form_GW.pdf (ACH authorization template)

From: Tara Green <tara.green@greenwave.io>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: accounts@greenwave.io
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 14:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Vendor master harmonization + onboarding checklist — GreenWave Logistics

Hi Evelyn — thanks for the clear notes. 

Quick answers:
- Legal name: GreenWave Logistics LLC (please use exactly this on POs).
- Remit address: 210 Harbor Way, Suite 400, Charleston, SC 29401, USA.
- AP contact: Andrea Morales, accounts@greenwave.io, +1 (843) 555-0198.

Regarding duplicate records: GW-23 is the older record we used for consulting engagements in 2023; GW-122 was created by our procurement team last month for software purchases. These should be merged; please keep GW-122 as the primary (it contains our current tax and banking info).

I'll attach the Bank Letter and W-9 in a follow-up email (want to confirm with our CFO before sending). ETA: I can get PDFs over by Monday morning (ET).

—Tara
Tara Green
Head of Finance Operations
GreenWave Logistics

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Sep 2026 10:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor master harmonization + onboarding checklist — GreenWave Logistics

Evelyn / team — noted. Per our vendor master process, here are the steps I will take once we receive the W-9 + bank letter: 

1) Verify tax name / EIN on W-9 matches GreenWave Logistics LLC and update the primary record (retain GW-122).
2) Deactivate GW-23 (set to historical record). Move any open or historical invoice references to GW-122; flag any PO re-association required for payments team.
3) Add remit address and AP contact to GW-122 profile; attach W-9 and bank authorization to vendor dossier.
4) Run a quick payment history query for the last 24 months to identify any payments that referenced GW-23 and create a short reconciliation task list.

Laura / Monica — once Karthik marks the merge complete, please update the PO intake spreadsheet and we will unblock PO issuance. If anyone needs an exception to issue an urgent PO before merge, reply-all with justification and I'll triage.

I'll log the merge request in VendorMaster (SUP-VM-849) and post the link here after submission.

Karthik
Vendor Data Lead
Redwood Inference

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tara Green <tara.green@greenwave.io>, accounts@greenwave.io
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor master harmonization + onboarding checklist — GreenWave Logistics

Tara — received the W-9 and bank letter you sent (thank you). Quick status update for transparency: 

- Karthik has submitted the merge request (VendorMaster SUP-VM-849). He flagged three historical invoice references to re-associate; finance will handle them as part of the next AR cycle.
- We've updated the primary supplier record to GW-122 with the remit address you provided and attached the new W-9 and bank authorization.
- PO issuance is unblocked for standard SOWs. For the initial integration engagement we will issue PO-5782 in the next 48 hours.

Next steps for GreenWave: expect a DocuSign for the bank authorization copy (we'll send a completed redacted copy for your records). If the AP contact or remit details change, please notify us immediately so we don't re-open the record.

Thanks again — smooth process.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Procurement Programs Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment references: W9_GreenWave_2026.pdf (attached by GreenWave), bank_authorization_form_GW.pdf (attached by GreenWave)
